table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Type,
	ServiceOCode,
	Date,
	Posted,
	Cancelled,
	Status,
	ServiceInvCode,
	SaleInvCode,
	Customer,
	RegNo,
	Patient,
	AccountName,
	PurOfServices = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SP.InvTotal) FROM ServicePurHeader SP WHERE SP.ServiceInvCode=T.ServiceInvCode), 0),
	Description,
	Amt = SUM(Amt),
	Discount = SUM(Discount),
	Tax = SUM(TAX),
	NetAmt = DBO.fn_GetServiceOrderTotal(T.ServiceOCode),
	Terms
FROM
	(SELECT
		Type='Services',
		ServiceOCode=H.ServiceOCode,
		Date = H.Date,
		Posted = H.Posted,
		Cancelled = H.Cancelled,
		Status = H.ServiceOrderStatusCode,
		ServiceInvCode = H.ServiceInvCode,
		SaleInvCode = H.SaleInvCode,
		Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE H.CustCode=A.AccCode),
		RegNo=(SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE H.PatientCode=P.PatientCode),
		Patient=(SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE H.PatientCode=P.PatientCode),
		AccountName = (SELECT MAX(A.Name) FROM Accounts A , SOReceipt R WHERE H.ServiceOCode = R.ServiceOCode AND R.ReceiptAccCode = A.AccCode),
		Description = SC.Name,
		Amt = SUM(D.Qty * D.Price),
		Discount = ISNULL(SUM(D.Qty * D.ServiceFlatDisc) + 
			SUM(D.Qty * (D.price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) +
			SUM(D.Qty * (D.price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (H.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + H.FlatDisc, 0),
		Tax = Round(Sum((D.qty * (D.price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.discperc * 0.01)) * 0.01 * D.servicegstPerc) +
			Sum(D.qty * D.serviceflattax ) +
			Round((Sum(D.qty * (D.price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - H.discperc * 0.01)) - H.flatdisc ) * 0.01 * H.serviceinvgstperc,2), 0),
		Terms = (SELECT MAX(R.ReceiptMode) FROM Accounts A , SOReceipt R WHERE H.ServiceOCode = R.ServiceOCode AND R.ReceiptAccCode = A.AccCode)
	FROM
		ServiceOHeader H, ServiceODetail D, Service SV, ServiceCategory SC
	WHERE 
		H.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		H.ServiceOCode = D.ServiceOCode AND
		D.ServiceCode = SV.ServiceCode AND
		SV.ServiceCatCode = SC.ServiceCatCode
	GROUP BY
		H.ServiceOCode,
		H.Date,
		H.Posted,
		H.Cancelled,
		H.ServiceOrderStatusCode,
		H.ServiceInvCode,
		H.SaleInvCode,
		H.CustCode,
		H.PatientCode,
		D.ServiceCode,
		SC.Name,
		H.FlatDisc,
		H.DiscPerc,
		H.MiscCharges,
		H.ServiceInvGSTPerc
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		Type='Parts',
		ServiceOCode=H.ServiceOCode,
		Date = H.Date,
		Posted = H.Posted,
		Cancelled = H.Cancelled,
		Status = H.ServiceOrderStatusCode,
		ServiceInvCode = H.ServiceInvCode,
		SaleInvCode = H.SaleInvCode,
		Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE H.CustCode=A.AccCode),
		RegNo=(SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE H.PatientCode=P.PatientCode),
		Patient=(SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE H.PatientCode=P.PatientCode),
		AccountName = (SELECT MAX(A.Name) FROM Accounts A , SOReceipt R WHERE H.ServiceOCode = R.ServiceOCode AND R.ReceiptAccCode = A.AccCode),
		Description = IC.Name,
		ServiceAmt = SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice),
		Discount = ISNULL(SUM(D.LooseQty * D.ItemFlatDisc) + 
			SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) +
			SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (S.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + S.FlatDisc, 0),
		Tax = Round(Sum((D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.discperc * 0.01)) * 0.01 * D.gstPerc) +
			Sum(D.LooseQty * D.UnitSalestax ) +
			Round((Sum(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - S.discperc * 0.01)) - S.flatdisc ) * 0.01 * S.InvGSTPerc1,2), 0),
		Terms = (SELECT MAX(R.ReceiptMode) FROM Accounts A , SOReceipt R WHERE H.ServiceOCode = R.ServiceOCode AND R.ReceiptAccCode = A.AccCode)
	FROM
		ServiceOHeader H, SaleLedger S, SaleInvDetail D, Item I, ItemCategory IC
	WHERE 
		H.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		H.SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode AND 
		S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
		D.ICode = I.ICode AND
		I.ICatCode = IC.ICatCode
	GROUP BY
		H.ServiceOCode,
		H.Date,
		H.Posted,
		H.Cancelled,
		H.ServiceOrderStatusCode,
		H.ServiceInvCode,
		H.SaleInvCode,
		H.CustCode,
		H.PatientCode,
		D.ICode,
		IC.Name,
		S.FlatDisc,
		S.DiscPerc,
		S.MiscCharges,
		S.InvGSTPerc1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		Type='Parts',
		ServiceOCode=H.ServiceOCode,
		Date = H.Date,
		Posted = H.Posted,
		Cancelled = H.Cancelled,
		Status = H.ServiceOrderStatusCode,
		ServiceInvCode = H.ServiceInvCode,
		SaleInvCode = H.SaleInvCode,
		Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE H.CustCode=A.AccCode),
		RegNo=(SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE H.PatientCode=P.PatientCode),
		Patient=(SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE H.PatientCode=P.PatientCode),
		AccountName = (SELECT MAX(A.Name) FROM Accounts A , SOReceipt R WHERE H.ServiceOCode = R.ServiceOCode AND R.ReceiptAccCode = A.AccCode),
		Description = IC.Name,
		ServiceAmt = SUM(D.Qty * D.SalePrice),
		Discount = 0.00,
		Tax = 0.00,
		Terms = (SELECT MAX(R.ReceiptMode) FROM Accounts A , SOReceipt R WHERE H.ServiceOCode = R.ServiceOCode AND R.ReceiptAccCode = A.AccCode)
	FROM
		ServiceOHeader H, IssueReqHeader S, IssueReqDetail D, Item I, ItemCategory IC
	WHERE 
		H.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		H.SaleInvCode IS NULL AND
		H.ServiceOCode = S.ServiceOCode AND 
		S.IssueReqInvCode=D.IssueReqInvCode AND
		D.ICode = I.ICode AND
		I.ICatCode = IC.ICatCode
	GROUP BY
		H.ServiceOCode,
		H.Date,
		H.Posted,
		H.Cancelled,
		H.ServiceOrderStatusCode,
		H.ServiceInvCode,
		H.SaleInvCode,
		H.CustCode,
		H.PatientCode,
		D.ICode,
		IC.Name) T
GROUP BY
	Type,
	ServiceOCode,
	Date,
	Posted,
	Cancelled,
	Status,
	ServiceInvCode,
	SaleInvCode,
	Customer,
	RegNo,
	Patient,
	AccountName,
	Description,
	Terms
